Ava (People Ops): Quick heads-up — Portland hub will be on a phased HVAC replacement across two consecutive weeks: Mon–Fri Apr 5–9 and Mon–Fri Apr 12–16. Expect noisy work windows and two full-day 2nd-floor closures (Thu 4/8 and Thu 4/15). If you planned to be onsite, please read options below. TL;DR: staggered access, coworking passes, limited hotel nights, shuttle changes.

Diego (Facilities): Full details from Facilities: crew on-site 7am–5pm most days. Actual work that impacts desks is concentrated 9am–4pm. We will cordon off the 2nd floor on 4/8 and 4/15 for HVAC hoisting and large equipment — no desk access those days. We'll post daily "facility status" updates in the calendar and Slack.

Marta (Eng): If my team is running hardware tests that week, any priority?

Ava (People Ops): Yes — if you need physical-access for hardware/networking reasons, flag it in the desk-booking form and select "priority access". We will prioritize racks, critical test benches, and newcomers bringing equipment.

Ravi (SRE): Parking/garage? I commute with a company badge and bike.

Diego (Facilities): Garage stays open but up to 10 spaces may be reserved for deliveries on 4/8 and 4/15. If those days affect you, we will validate parking — keep your receipt and mark the expense as "PDX HVAC parking". Bike storage unchanged.

Jin (ML): I have a multi-day experiment that needs the GPU workstation onsite. If 2nd floor is closed, can I get hotel nights?

Ava (People Ops): Yes — short hotel coverage is available for exceptional cases. We can cover up to 2 nights on the day before heavy closure if there's no quieter place to run your experiment remotely. To request: reply in this thread with dates + brief reason, or fill the quick form: https://intra.redwood/coworking-hvac (link internal).

Ava (People Ops): Alternative for most folks: coworking passes to CivicSpace (blocks reserved) or WeWork. If you prefer to avoid travel, request a CivicSpace pass and we'll send a QR badge. Passes issued daily, first-come-first-served.

Ava (People Ops): Shuttle update — the 8:15 AM downtown->PDX shuttle will shift to 8:30 AM on 4/5–4/16 due to traffic caused by delivery trucks. Evening return stays the same. If you rely on the shuttle, please plan for the 15-minute change.

Diego (Facilities): Quick shuttle schedule snippet we posted to the calendar:
```
AM: 7:45 (north stop) / 8:30 (downtown stop) -> PDX office
PM: 5:30 -> downtown / 6:15 -> north stop
Notes: 8:30 AM only 4/5–4/16, regular times resume 4/19
```

Marta (Eng): Thanks! If I switch to CivicSpace, how do I expense lunch or transit?

Ava (People Ops): For coworking: transit and lunch are personal expenses. If you need a hotel, use expense code "PeopleOps:HVAC-hotel" and attach confirmation. For urgent on-site work, we can pre-approve a per diem — ping me directly.

Ravi (SRE): Will IT power cycles or network interruptions happen?

Diego (Facilities): We don't plan to cut data-center power. There may be isolated breakers for HVAC circuits at 10am on 4/8 and 4/15 for testing — IT will post planned maintenance windows. No expected impact to server racks.

Ava (People Ops): Accessibility note: if you need a quiet room, ground-floor private office, or additional signage to navigate contractors, tell us and we'll set it up.

Jin (ML): Replying here to request 2 hotel nights for 4/7–4/8 (experiment run). Reason: GPU workstation noise-sensitive job requiring proximity to rack.

Ava (People Ops): Got it @Jin (ML) — booking hotels now. Please DM me your arrival time and any special check-in needs.

SiteBot (calendar-bot): Event created: "PDX HVAC — 2nd floor closures & facilities updates" (4/5–4/16). Daily reminders scheduled at 7:30 AM for affected days.

Marta (Eng): :thumbsup: thanks for the clear plan.

Ava (People Ops): We'll keep this thread updated with day-of status messages. If you have immediate access needs, DM Facilities or reply here with dates and reason. Thanks everyone for flexibility.
